name: Saturday Night Fever (11/9/96)

date.source: The broadcast's own dateline, 'TCW: Saturday Night Fever (11/9/96).'

matches.finish: Dr. Doom knocked out Fabio Erotic's stitches-cut cover with brass knuckles for the pin.
Jack the Ripper blocked a Rockslide Suplex and turned it into a small package for the pin.
Referee Tink Smith disqualified Tony Flint after his valet Jessica shoved Masked Bulldog off the top turnbuckle.
Scoult eliminated Steele with the Vaporizer (after Jack the Ripper tripped him at ringside), then made Carolina Crusher submit to a cobra clutch.
matches.stipulation: TCW World Title Tournament, Round 1 — triangle match

matches.finish: Dr. Doom hit the Doomsday DDT out of nowhere for the pin after a ten-minute beating.
Masked Bulldog ambushed Scoult before the bell, then finished him with an Atomic Bulldog off the top rope onto the concrete floor and a one-finger pin.
Brandon Charm caught the charging Scorpion with the Brandon Bomb for the pin.

notes: TCW's own first house show: the first round and semifinals of its inaugural nine-man World Title tournament. The scheduled final never happens on-page — Masked Bulldog is written out with an in-fiction larynx injury and the fed's own on-air 'President' authority-figure character (billed under the operator's own real name, which stands here per the poster-fed or in-character rule/PARTICIPATION TEST IS PER DOCUMENT) crowns Dr. Doom the first-ever TCW World Champion by default.
